verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll docs show it automatically calculates and files payroll taxes with agencies and lets employees view 'tax forms' (implying W-2/1099s) alongside pay stubs, suggesting year-end forms are generated and made accessible, but there's no explicit documentation describing automatic W-2/1099 generation, e-filing to SSA/IRS, or proactive distribution timing at year-end. Missing for 10: explicit description of automatic W-2/1099 generation process, confirmation of e-filing with tax authorities, and evidence of proactive distribution (email/notification) to workers at year-end rather than just on-demand viewing.
